objective: 请对当前 Quant 系统进行一次**从真实可运行闭环出发的全面审查、重构、验证与持续优化**，最终目标不是增加更多模块、策略、Agent 或“自我进化”概念，而是建立一个能够在严格风险约束下，从真实市场数据出发，完成 **observe → understand → generate decision → risk check → execute → broker fill → reconcile → PnL attribution → counterfactual evaluation → reflection → hypothesis → candidate strategy/model → offline validation → shadow/probation → live validation → promote/scale/pause/retire → repeat** 的完整自动闭环，并最终用长期、prospective、after-cost、risk-adjusted live net PnL 判断系统是否真正产生价值。第一步不要继续开发新功能，而是从代码、配置、数据库、journal、strategy registry、模型、文档和实际运行路径出发，对整个 repository 做一次事实级审查：明确每一个已经设计、实现或文档中声明的组件到底是否被真实调用、是否影响生产决策、是否有数据输入输出、是否存在只写了但从未使用的 dead code / unused feature / unused strategy / unused model / unused reflection / unused lifecycle / unused risk rule / duplicated abstraction / wrapper / historical path，并将所有能力分类为 **actively used / partially wired / implemented but unused / obsolete / duplicated / broken / missing**；特别检查“看起来已经有”但实际上没有进入真实交易闭环的功能，禁止把配置存在、函数存在、测试存在或文档存在等同于功能真正有效。随后以**最小可靠闭环优先**为原则进行重构，严格执行 **delete → merge → simplify → reuse → repair → only then add**：先删除或隔离无效和重复路径，统一唯一的数据流、控制流、状态来源、PnL ledger、strategy lifecycle、experiment registry、execution truth 和运行入口，确保主系统能够稳定完成一轮真实 end-to-end cycle，并为每一步建立明确输入、输出、责任边界、失败行为、日志、provenance 和自动测试。优先补齐当前真正决定系统能否学习的基础设施，包括完整 fill/trade/position/strategy/model attribution、realized/unrealized/net PnL、fees/slippage/cost accounting、BUY/SELL/HOLD counterfactual ledger、market/regime context、strategy lineage、experiment ledger、失败实验记录、模型预测与实际结果对齐，以及 lifecycle 的显式 state-machine invariants；任何 promotion、mutation 或自主修改都必须基于这些可验证证据，而不是 LLM 主观总结。将生产系统与研究/进化系统彻底分离：生产层只负责 data → decision → allocation → immutable Guardian → execution → reconciliation，学习层负责 diagnosis → hypothesis → candidate generation → backtest → walk-forward OOS → robustness → multiple-testing/overfitting control → shadow → small-capital probation → promotion/retirement；LLM 可以用于 reasoning、failure diagnosis、hypothesis generation、strategy proposal 和 research orchestration，但不得直接修改 Guardian、global risk limits、broker credentials、kill switch、audit rules 或未经验证直接修改 production behavior。不要把“交易次数更多”“HOLD rate 更低”“策略数量更多”“LLM 自己改代码”作为成功标准；先解释每一次 decision 是否正确，特别是对 HOLD 计算未来 counterfactual outcome，区分 good hold、missed alpha、avoided loss 和 false trade。对所有已有 strategy/model 建立 champion–challenger 和统一 StrategySpec，自动检测 semantic/behavioral duplicate，阻止 strategy zoo 无限制膨胀；新 candidate 必须说明它解决了什么已经观察到的 failure、与已有策略有什么本质区别、用了什么数据、经过了多少次搜索，并记录所有失败 trial，避免自动 data mining 和 selection bias。整个优化过程必须遵循“**先跑通闭环，再提高正确性，再提高研究能力，再增加自主性，最后才扩大资金**”的顺序：Phase 0 先做到 syntax/import/tests/service startup/restart/recovery/broker reconciliation 全部 PASS；Phase 1 完成真实交易和 PnL attribution；Phase 2 完成 counterfactual 与 decision-quality evaluation；Phase 3 建立 strategy/model/experiment registry；Phase 4 建立严格 offline backtest、walk-forward、cost、leakage、stress 和 overfitting validation；Phase 5 完成 shadow trading；Phase 6 才允许 evidence-gated probation；Phase 7 根据 prospective live evidence 自动 promote/pause/retire；Phase 8 再加入 regime-aware portfolio allocation、model retraining 和 strategy evolution；只有前一阶段 exit criteria 全部满足才能进入下一阶段。每次修改后都必须运行统一的 `make verify` 或等价命令，至少验证 software、syntax/import、unit/integration、data integrity、point-in-time/no-leakage、PnL accounting、lifecycle invariants、Guardian bypass prevention、replay determinism、crash recovery、broker reconciliation、shadow/live consistency，并要求 `FAIL=0`；任何失败不能被 warning 或 fallback 掩盖。最终请输出并持续维护一份事实级系统文档，明确：① 当前真实运行架构和唯一 end-to-end data/control flow；② 所有组件的 used/unused/broken/missing 审查表；③ 当前闭环在哪里真正断裂；④ 哪些模块应该删除、合并、修复或保留；⑤ 每个阶段的具体实现任务、依赖关系、测试方法、exit criteria 和验证结果；⑥ 当前赚钱或亏钱到底由 signal、model、strategy、allocation、execution、cost 还是 regime 导致；⑦ 当前系统哪些能力已经有证据证明，哪些只是设计目标；⑧ 下一轮只选择对“真实 after-cost risk-adjusted live profitability”最有价值的 1–3 个改动执行。整个项目的最高原则是：**不要优化一个尚未闭环的系统，不要让无法归因的结果驱动学习，不要让未经验证的学习结果进入生产，不要用复杂度代替能力；先让每一条数据、每一个决策、每一个订单、每一美元 PnL 和每一次策略变化都可以追踪、解释、复现和验证，再逐步让系统自动学习和自动进化。最终唯一有效的外部成功标准是：在固定风险边界和真实交易成本下，系统能否持续产生可复现、可归因、经样本外和 prospective live trading 验证的正净收益，而不是回测数字、策略数量或自治程度本身。**

Second ADD step done: `make verify`, the single gate the objective asks for, with 13 check classes plus two guards on the gate itself (test-coverage-map fails if a test file is unassigned, class-coverage fails if a class has no tests). 17 classes, 0 failed, 447 distinct tests, 91/91 audit, doctor RESULT OK, exit 0. Two previously-uncovered classes were real gaps I had to close first: point-in-time/no-leakage had NO test at all in the most leak-prone code in the system (added 6 tests asserting a decision is never paired with a price at or before its own timestamp, pre-horizon quotes are unused, out-of-order records sort by time, and late decisions stay pending — then run over the live journal), and replay determinism is now asserted (evaluation does not mutate input; journalled verdicts recompute from the journal). Committed ba85123. The gate found three things: (1) six strategies were admitted (journal accepted=true) but have no registry file and no recorded retirement — journal and registry disagree; cause recorded as UNKNOWN in docs/superpowers/known_state_findings.json because runtime/ is gitignored and no synthetic retirement event was fabricated; cannot recur since admit() writes atomically before returning accepted. (2) Shadow trading does NOT exist — probation is real (3 cycles) and live mode is hard-blocked, but "shadow" is docstring-only, so the class asserts what exists and prints the gap. (3) The integrity checker was wrong three times first: invented entry_rules/exit_rules/risk_rules that StrategySpec never had, treated journal events carrying a cycle_id foreign key as duplicate cycles (228 phantom double-writes), rejected BASELINE/PROBATION as unknown lifecycles, required non-empty parameters when HOLD_BASELINE legitimately has none, and crashed when runtime is outside the repo. It is now guarded by 16 tests that plant each violation, including a NEW admitted-without-file strategy so the exception list cannot become a blanket disable. make verify-self-test proves the gate can fail on 5 conditions and caught a flaw in itself first time (it registered the canary in the map, so the unclassified-file assertion never fired — a false pass). The gate also produced two false failures that were its own bugs, now fixed: probation asserted against StrategyEngine instead of StrategySelector, and minictrl run through the Python interpreter. Daemon active, 920 cycles, last cycle 2026-09-28 15:59:59 EDT, HOLD via llm at 765.49, market open.
progressNotes.next: Rebuild the stale native Todo manifest against actual state (it still lists simplify/repair as pending and has no counterfactual or verify items), then reconcile the remaining gaps the gate itself surfaced rather than adding features: the objective's experiment registry and offline validation path are not implemented (search for experiment/registry shows no such module), and `MIN_AGENT_MAX_ACCOUNT_VALUE` still needs the one real full-corpus run after 09:30 EDT to confirm the non-allowlist BIL/TLT exposure no longer blocks a BUY — earlier budget-limited checks only tested SPY alone. Also update STATUS.md with the verify gate.

Third ADD step: the two loop stages that did not exist, found by auditing all 16 named stages against code. (1) Offline validation was missing — candidates went from admission straight into PROBATION and traded real paper orders. The obvious implementation (replay the strategy's rule against history) would have been theatre, because a strategy is NOT an executable rule in this system: parameters["action"] is never checked on the execution path and TREND_FOLLOW's reference_price/threshold_pct are read only by validation and admission, never at trade time. So offline_validation.py screens each strategy on the counterfactual verdicts of the decisions it actually produced — unfittable, no rule to overfit, every number traceable to a journalled row. It can only reject, never promote (a test enumerates the verdict space to prove no promoting path). Live: 4 screened through, 2 rejected, 10 inconclusive; both rejected strategies were independently already PAUSED by the lifecycle manager. Screening at admission time alone was structurally incapable of rejecting anything (new candidates have no history), so it also runs across the whole library each maintenance pass. (2) Experiment registry implemented as a derived VIEW, not a store — every link is already journalled, so a persisted registry would be a second source of truth. A test asserts it exposes no save/write/append. 35 strategies, 23 admitted, 15 incomplete chains (all but one historical). Three wiring bugs caught by tests before production, all the same shape — code that looked connected and was not: strategy_library.get does not exist (AttributeError swallowed by a broad except, so every run journalled FAILED and nothing was ever paused); event.get("payload") called on JournalEvent models rather than dicts; and _apply_offline_rejection trusted its caller to check the verdict, so calling it directly paused a first-cycle candidate just told INCONCLUSIVE. Also found NEUTRAL was being counted as failure, which rejected tiny-fixed-size-001 on 15 neutral decisions — the largest PnL contributor on record (+362.66); silence is not failure. Shadow trading is NOT missing: it is merged into probation deliberately. Evidence — trend-follow-sell-002 is in PROBATION now and has already submitted a real broker order through the full path; tiny-fixed-size-001 (13 orders), fixed-size-buy-001 (6), trend-follow-buy-001 (4) all traded and all passed through probation. In a paper-only system with live mode hard-blocked, probation already exercises the complete real execution path, and a separate shadow executor would be a second execution truth that drifts from the real one. Exposure rules verified against the REAL account rather than a fixture: 5 positions worth $37,082, all outside the allowlist; a BUY of 5 SPY is APPROVED (scoping fix works); the $20,000 cap still binds on the agent's own book ($15k approves, $19k rejects naming agent exposure); the optional max_account_value backstop rejects correctly; the $5,000 per-position limit is what refuses larger single orders. make verify: 17 classes, 0 failed, 472 distinct tests, 91/91 audit, doctor OK, exit 0; verify-self-test green on 5 conditions. Commits 15eaa91, c9409a5, e6ec14f.
progressNotes.next: Two things remain, and neither is a new feature. First, close the one live incomplete experiment chain: trend-follow-20260612-006 is in PROBATION with zero evaluation evidence — it needs a reflection window to complete, which is market-time dependent, so it should be re-checked after the next open rather than forced. Second, and the only genuine gap left in the chain, is the one shadow could not supply: prospective live evidence that a candidate deserves to be trusted at size. That is the final success criterion (long-term, prospective, after-cost, risk-adjusted live net PnL) and it cannot be manufactured — it requires accumulated market time. The honest next engineering step is therefore not more code but confirming the system keeps a clean, auditable record while that time passes: re-run make verify after the next session opens, confirm the counterfactual grows on new cycles, and confirm trend-follow-20260612-006 acquires evaluation evidence. A full requirement-by-requirement audit against the objective should then be performed before any completion claim.

Re-read the FULL objective (it had been truncated in earlier turns) and it changes the picture. Two things: (1) it names a Phase 0-8 ordering with a strict "only enter a phase when the previous one's exit criteria are met" rule, and Phase 4/5/6 are backtest+walk-forward+cost+leakage+stress+overfitting, then SHADOW TRADING, then evidence-gated probation. (2) I WITHDREW my earlier "shadow is merged into probation" decision — the reasoning was sound but it was wrong against this contract, which names shadow as its own phase. Shadow is recorded as missing; Phase 5 is outstanding. The underlying observation is kept as a constraint for when it is built: a shadow executor must swap only the execution sink, not fork the decision path. Phase 0-3 confirmed met; Phase 8 correctly not started. Crash recovery is now PROVEN rather than configured: SIGKILL with no cleanup, NRestarts 0->1, new MainPID, pidfile rewritten, 920 cycles + 5782 events re-read cleanly, journal re-parsed with zero corrupt lines, daemon resumed journalling within a minute. Phase 4 built in a separate src/min_agent/research/ package with a make verify check that FAILS if any production module imports it, so production/research separation is machine-checked rather than conventional. The backtest executes the declared StrategySpec rule (HOLD_BASELINE control, FIXED_SIZE, TREND_FOLLOW), long-only matching the production executor, cost charged both sides because the paper broker charged zero. Three of my own controls were wrong first time and the module says so: the leakage guard only watched the loop index go backwards (which no rule could do, so it could not have detected the only leak that matters) and now re-asks each rule truncated to its decision bar, with a test that plants a peek-ahead rule; the overfitting control computed threshold/trials where threshold=0.0 so 0.0/40=0.0 and searching 40 variants cost nothing, and now raises required independent OOS trades on a sqrt schedule; one jitter seed is not a stress test and the first seed made a long position BETTER (+28.97 vs +26.14 baseline) so the worst of five is kept and they span +8.74 to +39.61. "Overfitted" was being returned for strategies with one trade per fold, which claims generalisation without enough trades to generalise from, so thin data is now reported as thin first. Honest result over all 27 strategies and 467 distinct real observations: 27 of 27 INSUFFICIENT, 3 OOS trades against the 10 required for 27 trials — not one strategy in the registry has enough out-of-sample evidence to be called anything. That agrees with three independent lines of evidence already on record (3 strategies with verified PnL, hold quality 0.687, 27/27 statistically unproven). Also found a real dedupe blind spot: behavioural_signature returned None for every TREND_FOLLOW so no TREND_FOLLOW was ever compared to any other and the zoo check was blind to all twelve; it now returns a signature, exposing 14 redundant copies including three exact duplicates (trend-follow-20260611-001/-002/-003 at ref 100.0 thr 0.02, -004/-005 at 150.0/0.01), and a semantic duplicate — trend-follow-sell-002 is named "Trend Following Sell Strategy" but its kind is FIXED_SIZE with no threshold or reference price, so it does not trend-follow at all and is identical to fixed-size-sell-001 apart from a confidence value. Commit a3f0b61. make verify: 19 classes, 0 failed, 531 distinct tests, 91/91 audit, doctor OK, exit 0.

Phase 5 built: shadow trading. MIN_AGENT_SHADOW=1 replaces the final broker call and nothing else - real data, real model, real Guardian, real journal, only submission replaced - so the path being validated is the same path that will trade. A config flag rather than a fourth `mode`, because `mode` already carries a hard safety meaning (anything but paper raises at load) and overloading it with "paper but pretend" would blur the line that must stay sharp. The safety property is negative and is the point: a shadow order is NOT a fill. status=SHADOWED is a distinct value rather than a reuse of SKIPPED so any branch that does not know it will not count it as executed; order_id is always None so no reconciliation can match it to a broker order; and a journal of four shadow orders yields realized PnL None, account_return_pct None, closed_lot_count 0, linked_fill_count 0. If a shadow order ever reached the PnL ledger as executed, the account would book profit from money never risked and an unvalidated path would look like the best on record - the most dangerous bug this system could have, because the loop would lie while looking healthy. A make verify check now enforces it across every production module (no module may group SHADOWED with an executed status) - a gate not a test because a new `if` on execution.status is exactly when it would be reintroduced; proven to fire by planting a grouping, and it was itself wrong first run, failing on the Literal that DECLARES the statuses, which is how a gate earns a reputation for noise. Verified against the live journal: SHADOWED, order_id None, one SHADOW_ORDER_INTENT event, cycle count unchanged 920/920 (a shadow intent is not a cycle), account realized PnL None. Three mistakes, all the same shape as before: append_event takes a JournalEvent not kwargs so TypeError was swallowed by a broad except and every shadow intent was silently dropped (third JournalEvent/dict confusion in this work); the event type was missing from JournalEventType raising ValidationError through the same except; and the sink-selection function was anchored on `def _build_loop(` which does not exist in cli.py so both call sites were rewritten and the definition never landed, caught by the startup test as an unbound name. The except is correct and stays (a journal fault must never escalate into a real order) but now records into ShadowExecutor.journal_failures instead of discarding, with a test asserting a healthy journal leaves it empty so the counter cannot rot. Also caught that shadow-live-consistency was still printing "shadow mode NOT implemented" after shadow was built because its string was never updated - a check that prints a falsehood is worse than no check; it now verifies shadow is reachable from config, off by default, and that the switch parses strictly (MIN_AGENT_SHADOW=flase raises rather than silently enabling a flag that decides whether real orders reach a broker). Three more objective requirements implemented, all as derived views over the journal rather than new stores. (1) Lineage did not exist: StrategySpec has no lineage field at all, so nothing linked a strategy back to the failure it was proposed to fix; the link does exist in the curriculum event (exploration summary + task_id), so it is derived. (2) Search effort left no trace: the live journal holds 69 proposals across 63 task ids and task-20260611-002 produced THREE variants - a search whose surviving sibling inherits that selection, invisible without a trial count. search_effort now reports proposals, distinct tasks, tasks that searched, and max variants per task. (3) No champion existed: two ACTIVE strategies and no benchmark. The champion is designated from broker-verified strategy-level PnL only - fixed-size-buy-001 at +120.37, highest of the two ACTIVE strategies with verified PnL. Naming one from cycles or an in-sample backtest would be choosing a benchmark on evidence the system already distrusts, so with nothing verified the answer is None and the report says why. Live findings: 33 candidates from 31 tasks, 1 task searched, max 3 variants, and 33 of 33 candidates cannot state what observation motivated them - not one candidate in the system's history recorded the observation that produced it, because the proposal schema requires only free-text rationale. Reported, not backfilled: inventing a justification after the fact would be worse than recording that none was given. Four mistakes, three the same shape as before: the doctor check was DEFINED AND NEVER CALLED (anchor didn't match) - the "implemented but unused" category this audit exists to eliminate, created in the commit hunting for it; the new reachability gate is itself wrong twice, first a double-escaped regex matching a literal backslash, then subtracting name SETS which cannot work because every called name is also a defined name so the sets are identical and the subtraction empties to nothing (it reported all 17 checks as unreachable) - it now distinguishes call sites by position; ReflectionMemory was used but never imported in doctor.py, the NameError swallowed by the check's own except Exception, leaving results empty and the report claiming champion=NONE while a champion was on file; and the champion reason read "the only such strategy on record" when two qualified, so it now counts qualifiers and names the runner-up.
